jobs.title: Graduate Planner (Major Projects) - Water - 2027 (Glasgow)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

With Every Community, Stantec Redefines What’s Possible.

Application Deadline:
Recruitment is ongoing. Please apply as soon as possible as the advert may close once we have sufficient applicants.

The Opportunity

Join our 2027 Graduate Programme as a Graduate Planner (Major Projects) in our Glasgow office, where you will support major water sector programmes and nationally significant infrastructure projects across the UK.

You will join our national project planning team, which includes 15 colleagues across nine offices, with Glasgow and Reading acting as key planning hubs. The role sits within the Water sector and will support projects nationwide across the wide range of long-term frameworks we hold with water companies.

You will support Strategic Resource Options, which are major projects due to their scale, project cost and nationally significant status. Working under the guidance of a senior planner, you will contribute to Stantec’s design delivery across stages ranging from concept design through to construction phase support.

Take a look at our Water business line here: Water (stantec.com), and review the career journey of some of our early careers professionals here: Career Stories | Stantec.

About The Role

As part of our Major Projects planning team, you will support programme planning, reporting and governance activities that help major water sector projects progress effectively. Your core responsibilities include:

Creating NEC3/4 CL31 and CL32 Primavera P6 programmes.
Updating P6 programmes with monthly progress information.
Producing reports, data analysis and governance materials.
Contributing programme information during client updates.
Supporting collaboration workshops with project design teams and discipline leads.
Supporting compliance with NEC conditions of contract in the production of tender and contractual programme documentation.

We are committed to supporting employees in achieving relevant professional qualifications and accreditation. This role will support professional development through the APM pathway, alongside in-house training and shadowing in Primavera P6, NEC training, QSRA training, Power BI training and wider project planning team learning opportunities.

Your Impact

This role will help deliver better outcomes for communities and the environment by supporting the planning and delivery of nationally significant water sector projects. Your work will contribute to effective programme management, governance and collaboration across major projects that support long-term water resilience and infrastructure delivery.

About You

At Stantec, we value your potential over past experience. Along with your Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering and a keen interest in the water industry, we’d love to receive your application if you are:-

An adapter: you’re able to remain calm in new and changing situations, comfortably switching between a variety of dynamic and exciting tasks.
A Perseverer: you stay composed in the face of setbacks, approaching challenges with confidence and determination.
A Collaborator: you work effectively with lots of different people, considering other’s perspectives to shape better outcomes.
A Problem-Solver: you love to give your thoughts based on what you see, being unafraid to challenge conventional thinking.

Please note, we ask our graduates to come into the office 4 days per week, to ensure that colleagues are able to provide the appropriate level of support.

Applicants must have an unconditional right to live and work in the UK for an indefinite period without limitation.

What We Can Offer You

A competitive salary
Private medical insurance
A range of benefits, including holiday buy and sell, group income protection and life assurance
Permanent employment contract to demonstrate our commitment to your long-term career at Stantec
Professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered with ICE.
A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )

Please take a look at our Graduate FAQs (
Graduate Application FAQs
) if you have any questions. We look forward to receiving your application!

Our teams provide effective and relevant solutions, translating our clients’ vision into valued consents, deliverable plans for projects and programmes, and efficient designs for delivery, based on technical excellence and deep market insights. jobs.title: Graduate Environmental Planning Consultant
jobs.description:
Location: London, Birmingham or Leicester

Start Date: September 2027

Joining Tetra Tech as a graduate is more than starting a new job – you’ll become part of our Next Gen Talent development programme, designed to support you as you build your career with us. Alongside hands-on experience and exposure to real projects, you’ll benefit from a structured programme of regular learning, training and development opportunities, helping you grow your technical and professional skills as you progress.

You’ll be supported throughout your development by experienced colleagues, giving you the opportunity to learn, build your network and develop the skills and experience needed for a successful long-term career with Tetra Tech.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

Tetra Tech Europe is an industry-leading multi-national, multi-disciplinary consultancy. Our Environmental Planning Team supports the continued growth of the UK Environment, Sustainability & Planning (ESP) team and wider business, delivering environmental co-ordination, EIA and related assessment and management work across renewables/energy, water/utilities, residential, defence, infrastructure, waste and minerals. You’ll join a team with an established workload, a strong reputation, ISEP EIA Quality Mark membership and active involvement in industry working groups, presentations and conferences.

Your Impact in this position

Working with support from senior colleagues, you’ll contribute to environmental planning, optioneering and impact assessment across a varied project portfolio. You’ll help deliver work to programme, budget and quality standards, build your skills in project management, business development and technical assessment, and produce technically robust outputs that inform responsible project decisions.

5 Core Capabilities

Project Co-ordination Support – Support project managers across multiple projects, working with teams, stakeholders and subcontractors, and helping programme site surveys.
Environmental Impact Assessment – Assist with screening, scoping, data collection, impact assessment and reporting, with working knowledge of EIA Regulations and the EIA process.
Report Writing and Communication – Prepare clear reports such as EIAs and CEMPs, present findings where needed, and review deliverables for accuracy and compliance.
Collaboration Across Disciplines – Work with colleagues in air quality, biodiversity, land use, transport and other teams to assess impacts and mitigation.
Technical Specialism Development – Build expertise in climate change, socio-economics, human health, natural capital or construction phase environmental management.

Training, Qualifications & Experience

A Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Environmental Sciences, Environmental Management or a related field, plus academic and/or practical EIA experience. Knowledge of environmental laws, regulations, guidelines and the UK planning/consenting process is essential, alongside strong communication, coordination, time management, problem-solving, attention to detail and analytical skills.

Working Environment

This is a graduate role based in a supportive consultancy environment, with hybrid working available in line with team and project needs. As you develop in the role, there will be an expectation to spend more time in the office initially to support learning, collaboration and onboarding. The role may also involve occasional travel to site or other offices as required.

Application Closing Date: 31st October 2026

Assessment Centre to be held: February 2027

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity.

We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems.

In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day-to-day role

jobs.title: Strategic Planning Consultant
jobs.description:
At Buro Happold, we are redefining what great cities look like—creating places that are sustainable, inclusive, and resilient. We are now seeking an Strategic Planning Consultant to join our Global Urban Strategies team, playing a key leadership role in shaping city-scale solutions across the UK and internationally.

The role will be based from our London office with hybrid working.

We are looking for a person passionate about solving the challenges facing cities who has specialist urban and strategic planning skills to join our London based team.

You will have an opportunity to play a role in shaping and delivering projects combining our data analytics and urban modelling with our core strategic advisory, planning, economics, infrastructure and environment capabilities.

You should have 2+ years post qualification experience. We are looking for a talented urban planner who is a team player and strong project collaborator.

Required Skills

Demonstrate an understanding of urban development challenges and the value of providing integrated urban development and strategic planning solutions.
Excellent problem solver able to interpret and understand the implications of analytical outputs
Awareness and understanding of what it takes to deliver effective and viable client outcomes in a commercial working environment.
Ability to liaise with internal and external clients to promote urban and regional development solutions and deliver high quality input into their projects.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable working with quantitative datasets and building clear data-driven narratives
Demonstrate an ability to prepare high-quality reports of a technical nature.

Specialist technical
and sector expertise
in one or more of the following areas:

Strategic advisory for urban plans, programmes and projects
Preparation of regional and city scale planning frameworks
Development planning and masterplanning of large-scale mixed-use developments
Data analytics and geo-spatial analysis
Understanding of how statutory plan-making systems work: policy hierarchies, evidence requirements and approval processes and the ability to transfer that thinking into unfamiliar national and regional planning contexts.
An awareness of the factors that determine whether plans and projects are deliverable, land ownership and assembly, phasing, infrastructure funding, and governance and delivery arrangements and a willingness to develop this understanding.
Preparation of projects and programmes to support urban development including infrastructure planning and business case for economic, social and green infrastructure programmes and projects.
Demonstrate strong cultural and institutional awareness, recognising how governance structures, land tenure and delivery mechanisms differ between geographies and shape what is deliverable.
Competent in GIS (QGIS or ArcGIS) for spatial analysis and the production of publication-quality mapping;

Desirable Skills

Familiarity with the UK plan-making system, including the NPPF, Local Plans and the emerging spatial development strategy regime for strategic authorities.
Involvement in delivering integrated urban development, strategic spatial planning projects.
Experience in urban resilience, climate change mitigation and adaptation, strategic environmental management and sustainable development strategies
Involvement in delivering regional planning, masterplanning and urban design projects
Working familiarity with CAD (2D and 3D) — in particular georeferencing and converting CAD masterplan, survey and land-parcel drawings for use in GIS
Experience using Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, or similar graphics software
Foreign language skills
Experience of planning practice in more than one country, or of adapting methodologies developed in one regulatory context for use in another
Willingness to travel for client meetings and workshops.

Qualifications

Essential - Degree in a field allied to strategic urban planning such as geography, town planning, social science, geographic information science, environmental science, or architecture.
Desirable - Masters degree in urban planning, spatial planning, urban design, or similar
Desirable – RTPI chartered or with a clear route to Licentiate/Chartered membership; equivalent international body considered.

Role & Responsibilities

Developing tailored consulting technical solutions; delivering an approach that adapts to our clients understanding, experience and needs.
Undertaking pieces of planning and urban development research to feed into projects.
Preparation of technical reports and client presentations.
Engaging with Buro Happold colleagues from other technical disciplines and / or external collaborators to provide integrated reports and solutions for our clients.
Coordinating inputs from other disciplines into integrated deliverables and maintaining the quality, traceability and internal consistency of project outputs, including comment tracking and client response
Contributing towards innovation, technical capability and skills development initiatives and programmes.
Support senior members of the team in preparation of proposals, fee estimates and bid material
You may be required to work on projects either the UK or overseas as the need requires.
The post holder must at all times carry out their duties with due regard to the BuroHappold Equality & Diversity Policy.
You are required to set a personal example in all aspects of Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S).
You are responsible for encouraging and maintaining high standards of OH&S in all areas under your control; meeting or exceeding targets and reporting on OH&S Key Performance Indicators. You will ensure compliance with the Company’s health and safety policy, relevant legislation and guidance in these areas.
You are required to fulfil the duties appropriate to your grade as detailed in the Roles & Responsibilities section of the Company’s Health & Safety Management System

Apply today and be where exceptional is everywhere.

A place for everyone

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment. We are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Planning Consultant
jobs.description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

The Opportunity

Our award-winning Town Planning team are seeking to recruit and Associate/Associate Director to join our Birmingham office to support the leadership and growth of the team. This is a great opportunity to work with Arup planning leadership nationally to develop and grow the Birmingham planning team. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and challenging projects using your leadership, consulting and technical skills.

We would welcome applications from candidates with development management experience to deliver our diverse portfolio of work. What is key to the role is an understanding of the planning context in Birmingham and the West Midlands, with strong work winning skills to maximise our presence in the area.

You will have the opportunity to work across a portfolio of development management projects including commercial, residential, regeneration and infrastructure. You will work closely with the Planning Lead for the Mid-West region which includes the Bristol, Cardiff, Nottingham and Birmingham offices, as well as working closely with various sector leads within the Arup planning team. You will also provide leadership to multidisciplinary planning and design teams.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

Is this role right for you?

The role will have a focus on leading and developing the development management service offer in Birmingham, developing client relationships and identifying project opportunities such as bidding and delivering projects to support raising Arup's profile and promoting our work in the marketplace. You will play a key role in growing our market profile in Birmingham and West Midlands by engaging with existing and potential clients, positioning Arup to ensure there is a strong pipeline and identifying opportunities for new work.

Skills

The role will also involve leading the delivery of projects in terms of client interface, providing strategic direction to the team, ensuring QA and ensuring projects are profitable. This will include interfacing with multi-disciplinary project teams across Arup to ensure client/project opportunities are maximised and integrated delivery of projects. You will have the following skills and attributes:

Education to degree and/or masters in Town Planning and a Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (MRTPI).
Experience of working in Birmingham in a development management with a good understanding of the market.
Experience of working within a commercial environment (bids and projects), including client liaison, programme and time management, quality assurance and financial/budget control.
In-depth knowledge and application of planning legislation and policy, including ongoing reforms.
Proven consultancy skills, working with clients to understand their requirements and business development.
A background in managing teams in the bidding and delivery of projects and sourcing sub-consultants where necessary.

Not ready to apply just yet or have some questions? Contact Rachel Connolly at rachel.connolly@arup.com - Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefitsto help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Rachel Connolly at rachel.connolly@arup.com
to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

Preparation of projects and programmes to support urban development including infrastructure planning and business case for economic, social and green infrastructure programmes and projects.
Demonstrate strong cultural and institutional awareness, recognising how governance structures, land tenure and delivery mechanisms differ between geographies and shape what is deliverable.
Competent in GIS (QGIS or ArcGIS) for spatial analysis and the production of publication-quality mapping;

Desirable Skills

Familiarity with the UK plan-making system, including the NPPF, Local Plans and the emerging spatial development strategy regime for strategic authorities.
Involvement in delivering integrated urban development, strategic spatial planning projects.
Experience in urban resilience, climate change mitigation and adaptation, strategic environmental management and sustainable development strategies
Involvement in delivering regional planning, masterplanning and urban design projects
Working familiarity with CAD (2D and 3D) — in particular georeferencing and converting CAD masterplan, survey and land-parcel drawings for use in GIS
Experience using Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, or similar graphics software
Foreign language skills
Experience of planning practice in more than one country, or of adapting methodologies developed in one regulatory context for use in another
Willingness to travel for client meetings and workshops.

Qualifications

Essential - Degree in a field allied to strategic urban planning such as geography, town planning, social science, geographic information science, environmental science, or architecture.
Desirable - Masters degree in urban planning, spatial planning, urban design, or similar
Desirable – RTPI chartered or with a clear route to Licentiate/Chartered membership; equivalent international body considered.

Role & Responsibilities

Developing tailored consulting technical solutions; delivering an approach that adapts to our clients understanding, experience and needs.
Undertaking pieces of planning and urban development research to feed into projects.
Preparation of technical reports and client presentations.
Engaging with Buro Happold colleagues from other technical disciplines and / or external collaborators to provide integrated reports and solutions for our clients.
Coordinating inputs from other disciplines into integrated deliverables and maintaining the quality, traceability and internal consistency of project outputs, including comment tracking and client response
Contributing towards innovation, technical capability and skills development initiatives and programmes.
Support senior members of the team in preparation of proposals, fee estimates and bid material
You may be required to work on projects either the UK or overseas as the need requires.
The post holder must at all times carry out their duties with due regard to the BuroHappold Equality & Diversity Policy.
You are required to set a personal example in all aspects of Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S).
You are responsible for encouraging and maintaining high standards of OH&S in all areas under your control; meeting or exceeding targets and reporting on OH&S Key Performance Indicators. You will ensure compliance with the Company’s health and safety policy, relevant legislation and guidance in these areas.
You are required to fulfil the duties appropriate to your grade as detailed in the Roles & Responsibilities section of the Company’s Health & Safety Management System

Apply today and be where exceptional is everywhere.

A place for everyone

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment. We are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

new_jobs.title: Senior/Principal Planning Consultant
new_jobs.description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

The Opportunity

Our award-winning Town Planning team are seeking to recruit and Associate/Associate Director to join our Birmingham office to support the leadership and growth of the team. This is a great opportunity to work with Arup planning leadership nationally to develop and grow the Birmingham planning team. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and challenging projects using your leadership, consulting and technical skills.

We would welcome applications from candidates with development management experience to deliver our diverse portfolio of work. What is key to the role is an understanding of the planning context in Birmingham and the West Midlands, with strong work winning skills to maximise our presence in the area.

You will have the opportunity to work across a portfolio of development management projects including commercial, residential, regeneration and infrastructure. You will work closely with the Planning Lead for the Mid-West region which includes the Bristol, Cardiff, Nottingham and Birmingham offices, as well as working closely with various sector leads within the Arup planning team. You will also provide leadership to multidisciplinary planning and design teams.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

Is this role right for you?

The role will have a focus on leading and developing the development management service offer in Birmingham, developing client relationships and identifying project opportunities such as bidding and delivering projects to support raising Arup's profile and promoting our work in the marketplace. You will play a key role in growing our market profile in Birmingham and West Midlands by engaging with existing and potential clients, positioning Arup to ensure there is a strong pipeline and identifying opportunities for new work.

Skills

The role will also involve leading the delivery of projects in terms of client interface, providing strategic direction to the team, ensuring QA and ensuring projects are profitable. This will include interfacing with multi-disciplinary project teams across Arup to ensure client/project opportunities are maximised and integrated delivery of projects. You will have the following skills and attributes:

Education to degree and/or masters in Town Planning and a Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (MRTPI).
Experience of working in Birmingham in a development management with a good understanding of the market.
Experience of working within a commercial environment (bids and projects), including client liaison, programme and time management, quality assurance and financial/budget control.
In-depth knowledge and application of planning legislation and policy, including ongoing reforms.
Proven consultancy skills, working with clients to understand their requirements and business development.
A background in managing teams in the bidding and delivery of projects and sourcing sub-consultants where necessary.

Not ready to apply just yet or have some questions? Contact Rachel Connolly at rachel.connolly@arup.com - Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefitsto help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different People, Shared Values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Rachel Connolly at rachel.connolly@arup.com
to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.
